== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[A Jedi's Focus (V)]]: the PC card image of [[A Jedi's Focus (V)]] (21 July 2024, [[:File:V23-L-ajedisfocus.gif|V23-L-ajedisfocus.gif]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (page 5). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
